data.name: Jessie
data.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Jessie is derived from the Hebrew word 'yissah,' meaning 'God is gracious.' This name was traditionally given to girls born during times of joy and abundance. In the Bible, Jesse is the father of King David, and his name signifies God's goodness and graciousness towards his people.

in_hebrew.name: יסי
in_hebrew.meaning: מתנה מאלוהים, חסד אלוהים, או אלוהים יעזור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יסי הוא צורה עברית שמקורה בשם העברי 'ישי' (ישׁי), שפירושו 'אלוהים יעזור' או 'מתנה מאלוהים'. הוא קשור קשר הדוק למסורת היהודית והוא שם חשוב במקרא. יסי הוא אביו של המלך דוד, ובכך הוא דמות מרכזית בהיסטוריה המקראית. השם מייצג את הרעיון של עזרה אלוהית והוא בעל משמעות עמוקה בתרבות היהודית והנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Ιεσσαι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιεσσαι (Jessai) είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος 'ישי' (ישׁי), που σημαίνει 'Θεός βοηθά' ή 'Θεός προσφέρει'. Στο Χριστιανισμό και την Ορθοδοξία, το όνομα αυτό διατηρεί τη σύνδεσή του με τη Βίβλο, καθώς ο Ιεσσαι είναι ο πατέρας του βασιλιά Δαβίδ. Η χρήση του ονόματος αυτού στην Εκκλησία και στην παράδοση αντικατοπτρίζει τη σημασία του στη θεολογία και την πνευματικότητα.

in_latin.name: Iessai
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Iessai derivatur ex hebraeo nomine 'ישי' (ישׁי), quod significat 'Deus adiuvat' vel 'donum Dei'. In traditione christiana, Iessai est pater regis Davidis, et nomen eius habet significationem profundam in historia biblica. Usus nominis Iessai in ecclesia et traditione christiana reflectit eius momentum in theologia et spiritualitate.

It is a name with a rich history and a meaning that resonates with the values of graciousness, joy, and abundance, making it a desirable choice for parents who want to give their daughters a name with significance and meaning.

It is a name that inspires us to live in the knowledge of God's grace and to extend that grace to others. The spiritual significance of the name Jessie is encapsulated in the Bible verse, "But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us." historical_references.reference: Jessie, daughter of Reynold I, King of Scotland, was born around 1473 and died in 1509. She married James IV of Scotland in 1488, and together they had seven children. This Jessie is also known as Lady Margaret Stewart.

Saint Jesse, or Sanctus Iesus, was a legendary king of the ancient Kingdom of Judah, who is said to have reigned from 931 to 993 BCE. According to tradition, Saint Jesse was the father of King David, and he is venerated as a saint in the Roman Catholic and Eastern Orthodox Churches.
